doc.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1960-09-03

title: Glover Compton and the tune Clock of Time
summary: Boote remembers pianist Glover Compton in Europe and Chicago; Allen asks about Clock of Time by Tony Jackson and Compton.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Sure, I remember Glover Compton. But he spent quite a few years in Europe. You know, he was a piano player. But now he... At least I don't know if he's living. And he was in New Orleans. He'd open the lounge there on 51st Street. Mm-hmm.
Do you remember the Clock of Time? A tune called The Clock of Time?
A tune called The Clock of Time.
It was written by Tony Jackson and Glover Compton.
And I think Glover's wife wrote it to him. Nettie.
You're such a pretty thing. Do you remember that? You're such a pretty thing. Might have been a bad lover.
He might have been all right,
but he wasn't such a pretty thing. But here over here,
